5.15pm A win with two overs to spare. Tamim Iqbal's brilliant ton had set up the chase 
and Nurul Hasan finished it with an unbeaten 39-ball 45. Just like all the games so far 
on this tour, Zimbabwe seemed to have things under control at times but they failed to 
seize those moments. Taylor's captaincy was a bit baffling as well. He didn't bring on 
Muzarabani earlier and kept throwing the ball to Tiripano, just like Bangladesh did with 
Saifuddin. 
Khalid: "What a knock from Nurul coming back to the team after so many days. Bravo!!" 
Andy: "Mature performance from two youngsters, keep it up" 
Time for the presentation ceremony. 
Brendan Taylor: 15-20 runs short. They paced the innings beautifully. Tamim showed 
his class today. We can take some positives out of it though. Regis has really found 
another gear, I am really pleased for him. Raza and Burl performed well after coming 
from injuries. Muzarabani is our strike bowler, Tiripano had found some rhythm and 
some reverse swing, so I stuck with him but they saw him off. 
Shakib Al Hasan is the Player of the Series. Shakib: Feels good to contribute for the 
team. Winning 3-0 against Zimbabwe in Zimbabwe is not easy. The pitch was really 
good today, and I feel I missed out. In T20Is, we have to be at our best as the game 
changes in the matter of an over. We will have to take it one game at a time. 
Tamim Iqbal is the Player of the Match. Tamim: Happy that I contributed for the team. I 
thought it was a very good wicket, they batted exceptionally well. They could have 25-30 
runs more but we bowled well in the last two-three overs. It was a good challenge for 
the batting unit and we responded well. Unfortunately, I won't be part of the T20 team 
because of my injury. I need to do rehab for 10-12 weeks. But all the best to the players 
and Eid Mubarak to everyone back home. 
Tamim collects the trophy and now the players are posing for the team photo. 
That's all from out side for this game. See you soon.
